name: css-ml
description: A neural network that recognizes hand-drawn digits in pure CSS. Zero JavaScript.

scripts.build:all: npm run build && .venv/bin/python latent-space/scripts/build.py && .venv/bin/python tic-tac-toe/scripts/build.py && .venv/bin/python rock-paper-scissors/scripts/build.py && .venv/bin/python connect-four/scripts/build.py && .venv/bin/python playground/scripts/build.py && .venv/bin/python autoencoder/scripts/build.py
scripts.test:all: npm test && node latent-space/tests/browser.test.mjs && node tic-tac-toe/tests/browser.test.mjs && node rock-paper-scissors/tests/browser.test.mjs && node connect-four/tests/browser.test.mjs && node playground/tests/browser.test.mjs && node autoencoder/tests/browser.test.mjs
